name: symfony/dom-crawler
reason: Package API (reassessed): Crawler::addXmlContent(string) loads the text with DOMDocument::loadXML (LIBXML_NONET forced) and the XML-mode Crawler exposes children()/nodeName()/attr()/text() traversal and filterXPath() with its own namespace discovery. Parser family libxml2 via DOMDocument, shared with the standard path and sabre/xml; package-own scope is navigation and XPath/namespace mapping, not tokenizing. v8.1.10 is the newest stable release (v8.2.0-BETA1 not used). Both shared controls match the expat oracle; Native AFL++ feedback from instrumented libxml2 parser and PHP ext/dom loading sources differs in 357 stable parse-time tuples between the controls. Downloads are mostly HTML crawling uses. Verified: projects/xml/php/symfony_dom_crawler.

name: symfony/serializer
reason: XmlEncoder::decode(string, xml) delegates XML syntax parsing to DOMDocument/libxml2, then maps the DOM to arrays. Both valid controls match the independently projected oracle for preserved fields. The root name and descendant namespace declarations are lost; package downloads measure the whole Serializer component, mostly other encoders. Native parser-only AFL feedback changes in 359 stable tuples; package-own Xdebug lines are separate. Verified: projects/xml/php/symfony_serializer.

name: jms/serializer
reason: deserialize($xml, $type, 'xml') loads SimpleXMLElement and then maps the already parsed tree onto typed objects through class metadata; it needs a target class model rather than producing a generic XML parse result.

name: prewk/xml-string-streamer
reason: Pinned valid-control probe shows getNode() returns raw XML byte slices by tag depth without element names, attributes, decoded text, namespace resolution, or entity decoding. README feeds slices onward to SimpleXML; it is a byte splitter, not the XML parser. Evidence: data/php/xml/prewk-xml-string-streamer-lead-check.json.

name: laravie/parser
reason: Pinned v3.0.0 (MIT) probe (local candidate commit e293b060) matched an expat oracle evaluating the same fixed schema, but Reader::load is simplexml_load_file and Document::parse only maps the already parsed SimpleXML tree onto a caller-provided schema; all 359 differing libxml2 tuples also differ under a bare simplexml_load_file and the full and parse-only maps are identical. Treated like the excluded serializer mapping layers; not counted.

name: orchestra/parser
reason: Source read at pinned v10.0.0 (7dfe57ee9cbf07853e09f620689e35e9f883b6ba, MIT; codeload archive sha256 8f529ce4649f3a995934b4aff8bfdc68aa2635553d6015b99f510b2c8f0a0cea): Xml\Reader and Xml\Document only extend laravie/parser's Reader and Document, adding a Laravel service provider, a facade, container-resolved schema filters and via(SimpleXMLElement), which takes an already parsed tree. Its extract/load/local/remote inputs are laravie's simplexml_load_string/simplexml_load_file calls. No parsing route of its own; excluded with laravie/parser as a schema-mapping layer, no build needed.

name: pear/xml_parser
reason: Documented XML_Parser setInputString()/setInputFile()/setInput() plus setHandlerObj() and parse() drives ext/xml xml_parser_create/xml_parse (libxml2 push parser via compat.c) and delivers SAX events to a handler object. Both valid controls match a raw-name Expat oracle (no namespace mode; xmlns declarations are attributes; documented $folding set to false). Xdebug covers 56 package lines and LLVM about 2,070 libxml2 lines (parser.c 956); native parser-scoped AFL changes 299 stable tuples, all also differing under a bare xml_parse baseline, so the package drives the parse but adds no own tuples. Packagist marks it abandoned; PHP 8.5 deprecation notices recorded. Verified: projects/xml/php/pear_xml_parser.

name: jtrumbull/xml-parser
reason: Pinned v1.0.2 (MIT) probe: documented XMLParser::decode() is new SimpleXMLElement($xml) plus json_decode(json_encode(...)), mostly an array-to-XML encoder package; the source has no xml_parser_create call (the earlier note was wrong). On both valid controls decode() output is identical to the bare SimpleXML JSON round trip and loses the root name, CDATA text, attributes of text-only elements and the prefixed p:amount child. No parsing route of its own; not counted. Evidence: data/php/xml/jtrumbull-xml-parser-lead-check.json.
